audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 5 read Skill on the full layer against Cassiopeia on the content layer and the packet, and row 6 read Veigar on the full layer against Cassiopeia on the content layer — with a why underneath it describing Cassiopeia hyper-carrying.
audit.why: Row 6 is the classic side-says-one-thing-why-says-the-other defect. Veigar genuinely owns that row: Phenomenal Evil is permanent AP with no cap and Primordial Burst scales on missing health, against a mage with no dash to leave Event Horizon.
audit.corrected: phases[3..5].side moved to Cassiopeia to match win[N]; row 6 kept with Veigar and win[6] flipped to Veigar in the same proposal, with phases[6].why and whys[6] rewritten to argue Veigar.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text credited Cassiopeia with 'your Golden Aegis on R' — an ability she does not have.
audit.why: Golden Aegis belongs to another champion entirely; Cassiopeia's R is Petrifying Gaze. The packet's suspectNames did not catch it because it is not a near-miss of a real Cassiopeia ability.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around the real late-game problem: no dash out of the cage, so Zhonya's and vision decide whether that fight happens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma was described as the anti-dive tool against a champion with no dash, and the missing-health scaling on Primordial Burst was never used to shape trading advice.
audit.why: Riot text on R: 'increasing based on the target's missing health.' Nothing in Veigar's kit is a movement ability, so Miasma here is a slow that pins him, not a grounding tool.
audit.corrected: Trading advice now says a half-health duel feeds his ult, and Miasma is framed as poison uptime on a champion who cannot leave it.

audit.why: It is the field that must carry real numbers.
audit.corrected: Event Horizon 20s at rank 1 to 14s at rank 5, Baleful Strike 6s to 4s, Petrifying Gaze 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to match their titles using the R facing rule and the missing-health scaling.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. edits.after: - Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 and 14s at rank 5, and only the EDGE stuns — sit near the centre or leave before it forms. - Baleful Strike is 6s down to 4s and permanently stacks his AP off kills. - Petrifying Gaze is 120s at rank 1: spend it on his step-up, never on poke.

edits.after: Veigar wins by trapping you in Event Horizon with no dash to leave it, then cashing a missing-health Primordial Burst.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, zone Veigar off the wave with fang threat, and call your jungler — your W makes every gank a guaranteed kill.

edits.before: If Veigar opens the score, reset expectations and respect Event Horizon (Cage) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q-E clears and stay relevant through grounded peel.
edits.after: If Veigar opens the score, respect the 20-second cage and stop fighting beside a wall he can trap you against. After a second kill, farm Q-E from max range and let stacks be the only thing he takes.

notes: Veigar is male — no pronoun defects. Removed a fabricated ability: spikes[3].text credited Cassiopeia with 'Golden Aegis on R', which is not in her kit and which the packet's near-miss check could not flag. Chart: rows 3-5 were full-layer Skill against content-layer Cassiopeia (moved to Cassiopeia); row 6 was full-layer Veigar with a why arguing Cassiopeia hyper-carries and win[6] saying Cassiopeia — I kept Veigar and flipped win[6] in the same proposal, rewriting both whys, because Phenomenal Evil is uncapped permanent AP and Primordial Burst scales on missing health against a mage with no dash. Veigar has no movement ability at all, so Miasma's grounding is dead here and I recast it as slow plus poison uptime. Not verifiable from the kit and therefore not written: the exact Dark Matter cooldown (the file lists 0 because Phenomenal Evil stacks reduce it), and whether Event Horizon's stun is applied on entry or on crossing the edge outward.
